title: Zeroize pixel-form secret residue and clear the panel GRAM/backlight on every lock, wipe and idle-timeout
threat: Post-lock SRAM dump, a later NS-reachable secure-world bug, or a powered-but-locked device whose TFT GRAM still holds the last wizard frame: the legacy `Display::cell` (720 B), the px `STRIP` static (13,696 B), `secret_rows_storage`/`wb` in the legacy mnemonic/candidate renderers, and the NV3007 GRAM all retain the last secret glyphs in pixel form after the wizard; `CMD_LOCK` only paints 'Locked'.
proposal: (1) Zeroize `cell` after each secret glyph blit and `STRIP` at the end of every forced frame (and at `invalidate_shown`), and zeroize `secret_rows_storage`/`wb` in `render_mnemonic_page` / legacy `render_candidate_screen` (the px twins already do). (2) On `cmd_lock`, idle-timeout wipe, tamper wipe and wizard exit: `fill_screen(BG)` the whole GRAM (not just the 16x4 text window), then de-assert LCM_EN / set AW99703 brightness 0 on pq1 and, where drivable, pulse the panel reset so GRAM is cleared in hardware. (3) Add a host test that the row/cell/strip buffers are all-zero after a forced frame completes.
rationale: Trezor clears both physical framebuffers on display init and gates FB access by MPU; pq1 keeps everything in S-SRAM (stronger) but never erases it. Residue in pixel form is a seed-recovery oracle for any future bug, and the GRAM case is a physical one (a locked device on a desk still holds the frame until overwritten).
repo_evidence: grep zeroize/Zeroize in secure/src/ui/lcd.rs, secure/src/ui/px/lcd.rs, pqsigner-ui-px/src/raster.rs, pqsigner-ui-px/src/font.rs: none
secure/src/ui/lcd.rs:111 (`cell: [BG; CELL_N]` persistent scratch, never cleared after a secret blit)
secure/src/ui/px/lcd.rs:304-322, 695-697 (forced frame invalidates SHOWN but does not zero STRIP)
secure/src/ui/seed_wizard.rs:414 (`show_status("Words shown")` overwrites the text window only)
gh #124 OPEN (secret residue twins — SE driver buffers only; framebuffers untracked)
vendor_precedent: Trezor core/embed/io/display/st-7789/display_fb.c:118-124 (`display_fb_clear` memsets both physical FBs) and DISPLAY_RESET_CONTENT mode; MPU revocation of the FB at refresh (vg-2864 display_driver.c:420-424).
risks: Zeroize must use the same volatile/compiler-fence discipline as other secret types (`zeroize::ZeroizeOnDrop`); a plain store can be elided. Blanking the GRAM on lock costs one full-frame SPI write (~20 ms). On pq1 the backlight enable is also the AW99703 HWEN — re-enabling needs the I2C re-program sequence already in `lcd_nv3007::init`.
